test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate form of comparative degree that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Maheshwari is three years __junior than me__.

options.text: junior than any other to me

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. junior to me .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"junior"** is a comparative adjective that does not take the word **"than"** after it. Instead, it is followed by **"to"**.
 
• In the given sentence, the usage of **"junior than me"** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct form of the sentence would replace **"junior than me"** with **"junior to me"**.

Correct sentence: *Maheshwari is three years **junior to me**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other adjectives like **senior, inferior, superior, elder, and preferable** also follow the same rule and take **"to"** instead of **"than"** after them.
 
• **Example:** She is senior to me in the company.
 
• Always remember this rule when using such adjectives in comparative degrees.
